description: Cobblemon Modpack for friends and family.
body:
## Cobblemon Modpack Overview

### What Awaits You
Dive into a vibrant world filled with **Cobblemon** animated fictional creatures spanning **all 9 generations**! This comprehensive modpack transforms your Minecraft experience into an immersive creature-collecting adventure.

### Key Features
- **🎯 Complete Cobblemon Collection** – Catch, train, and battle with Cobblemon from every generation
- **🏛️ Interactive World** – Explore gyms, villages, and hunt for legendary Cobblemon
- **🎒 Quality-of-Life Improvements** – Backpacks for easier inventory management
- **🗺️ Navigation Tools** – Built-in minimap for seamless exploration
- **⭐ Endgame Content** – Legendary Cobblemon encounters for the ultimate challenge

---

### What does your modpack add?
The modpack adds **Cobblemon** animated fictional creatures—and everything associated with their world.

### What features does it have?
- Cobblemon from all 9 generations
- Gyms and villages
- Legendary Cobblemon encounters
- Backpacks and minimap functionality

### Why would a user want to download it?
Users should download this modpack **primarily to collect Cobblemon from all 9 generations**—something the base game doesn't offer. The main entertainment comes from **collecting these fictional Cobblemon characters**.

---

**Enjoy your Cobblemon adventure!**

---

Note: **Particle Blocker** makes servers crash, remove this mod as it is client-side only, in case you want to use it with a server.
